On September 20, Qiyuan held a "Me and My Personal Robot" themed launch event, officially releasing the Qiyuan Q1 and T1 personal robots. Among them, Q1 is an 88-cm-tall small-size full-body force-controlled humanoid robot that folds into a backpack; T1 is the world's first transformable personal robot, capable of autonomously switching between wheeled-legged humanoid and quadruped forms.
